overview.about: The Pan American Games are the multi-sport championship of the Americas, held the year before the Olympics and often serving as a qualifier for them. Athletes from North, Central and South America and the Caribbean compete across a broad Olympic programme. The United States and Brazil are among the traditional powers.
overview.nextEvent: The next Pan American Games bring together the nations of the Americas across dozens of Olympic sports. For many athletes it is both a continental title and a pathway toward Olympic qualification.

@graph.name: Pan American Games
@graph.description: The 2023 Pan American Games were held in Santiago, Chile, from 20 October to 5 November. The event brought athletes from across the Americas to venues including the Estadio Nacional complex. Panam Sports is the continental governing body and publishes official Games news, results and future host information.
